audit insert failure retains running job/delivery; recreated execution adapter reuses published receipt and completes with one DDL step and one audit

assertions: Native planner derives index identity and ordered fields from the persisted job and trusted typed mapping.

Model -> registry -> intent -> job -> delivery lock order; no row lock spans DDL.
Stable job operation identity and original retained inputs reconcile published intent without repeating DDL.
Publication receipt version equals the eligible registry token on success.

Fresh adapter recovery is tested; actual process crash and lost network acknowledgement acceptance remain separate.
